name: 0.12mm Clear @Solder
notes: Transparent PETG profile. Every air gap inside the part scatters light, so this trades all structure and all speed for density: one wall, no top or bottom shells, 100% aligned rectilinear locked to 0 degrees, 0.5 mm lines everywhere, 15 mm/s. Pair with the filament preset Numakers PETG-HS Clear @Solder, which is the only place fan and flow can be set - 0% fan and flow 1.00 are half the recipe and this process profile does nothing useful without them. Zero shells means the part has no solid skin: this is for optical parts, not functional ones. adaptive_layer_height forced OFF. Supports OFF - a support contact face is a matte scar on a clear part. FLOW IS THE LARGEST SINGLE LEVER and rotation_distance 34.406 is nominal and unmeasured, so run E_CAL_START before reading anything into the result. Ceiling is semi-optical, never glass. Bottom face gloss comes from the build surface, not from this profile.
